# Onus Wood

> Australian timber lighting, made to order: pendants, wall sconces, floor lamps, task lamps and candelabras in a choice of Australian hardwoods. Prices in AUD including GST.

## Pieces
- [Cradle pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/cradle-pendant/): A shallow timber dome built from six wide segments, with the seams left on show and a warm pool of light beneath. From $1,480.
- [Daintree pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/daintree-pendant/): A tall timber cylinder of five curved staves, with light escaping through narrow vertical slots. From $2,280.
- [Flinders pendant](https://onuswood.com/product/flinders-pendant/): A small timber box pendant with finger-jointed corners and an open base. From $1,240.
- [Wollemi wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/wollemi-wall-sconce/): A linen shade held off a timber backplate by a single block arm. From $640.
- [Otway wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/otway-wall-sconce/): A curved timber wrap that hides the globe and washes light up and down the wall. From $780.
- [Freycinet wall sconce](https://onuswood.com/product/freycinet-wall-sconce/): A small domed timber disc with a slip-cast ceramic hood. Quiet enough for a bedroom. From $460.
- [Barrington floor lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/barrington-floor-lamp/): A slender timber stem, a frosted opal globe and a soft sage steel base. From $1,950.
- [Karijini task lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/karijini-task-lamp/): A marri task lamp with a swivelling aluminium joint and a shallow turned timber shade. From $2,380.
- [Daylesford floor lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/daylesford-floor-lamp/): A timber stem and base with a dusty pink spun steel dome. From $1,420.
- [Bright task lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/bright-task-lamp/): A timber task lamp with an orbital-sanded stainless pivot and a sage spun shade. From $690.
- [Lorne task lamp](https://onuswood.com/product/lorne-task-lamp/): A speckled slip-cast ceramic base, a timber collar and a frosted glass mushroom shade. From $680.
- [Myall candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/myall-candelabra/): A long timber bar carrying a row of frosted opal globes, for a dining table or kitchen island. From $2,450.
- [Coorong candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/coorong-candelabra/): Three spun shades in terracotta, sage and sand, hung from one timber canopy. From $1,980.
- [Kanangra candelabra](https://onuswood.com/product/kanangra-candelabra/): A timber frame holding a row of frosted glass rods, built for high ceilings and open-plan rooms. From $3,400.
